podcast.title: Presence in Amarok (1990)
podcast.body: Michael Field's "Amarok" album, released in 1990, features elements that highlight "the more romantic Michael Field." These romantic sensibilities are expertly interwoven with other genres like progressive rock and Celtic music, forming a rich and varied tapestry within the album's single, extended composition. "incluso en el Michael Field más romántico."

srcs.episode: Mike Oldfield - Amarok. ¿Es su mejor disco?

podcast.title: Motown's Embrace of Romantic Music
podcast.body: Motown Records also ventured into romantic music, alongside genres like R&B, funk, and disco, thereby broadening its influence on black music throughout the 1960s and 1970s. "incluso la música más romántica."
